assessment_objectives.objective: methods for coordinating sanitized event logs and security-relevant telemetry among external organizations when that data is shared across organizational boundaries are defined.
the sanitized event logs and security-relevant telemetry to be coordinated among external organizations when that data is shared across organizational boundaries are defined.

organization-defined methods for coordinating sanitized event logs and security-relevant telemetry among external organizations are employed when that data is shared across organizational boundaries to identify anomalous events.
